title: Board report of a significant controlled substance theft or loss
rule_summary: A Drug Store pharmacy, sterile compounding pharmacy, complex non-sterile compounding pharmacy, and nuclear pharmacy located in Massachusetts shall report a theft or loss of a significant amount of controlled substances by submitting to the Board a copy of the Report of Theft or Loss of Controlled Substance and DEA Form 106 within seven days of such theft or significant loss and, where applicable, shall comply with the reporting requirements of the DEA, the Department and the state and local police.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate adds the Board report, and its seven-day clock, to the federal theft or loss route instead of treating the DEA filing as the whole answer.

numeric_facts.fact: Board report of a theft or significant loss of controlled substances
numeric_facts.conditions: of such theft or significant loss; submitted with a copy of DEA Form 106

common_confusions: The Board report is owed by pharmacies located in Massachusetts and carries its own seven-day period, which is shorter than the federal period for the DEA Form 106.
verification_notes: Read in the official 247 CMR 20.03(7) text published at mass.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed. A fresh independent audit is still required before any section relying on it is published.
